long_biography.plain_text:
Acquisitions and construction are central to Ivan P. Jecklin's mandate at Weinstein Properties. He joined the Richmond-based company in 1994 after practising law in Chicago, and his remit now includes development, major capital works and commercial properties. The group has grown from a Virginia homebuilder into an owner and manager of apartment communities across several US states.

Jecklin studied at the University of Chicago before earning a law degree at Washington University in St Louis. Outside the property business, he served on the Virginia Museum of Fine Arts board and co-chaired its art acquisitions committee, presiding over meetings about additions to the collection.
